content: Halls is a well-known brand of mentholated cough drops, categorized by the manufacturer as both a cough suppressant and an oral anesthetic. These cough drops are produced by the Cadbury-Adams Division of Cadbury-Schweppes. The origins of Halls date back to the 1930s in Britain, where they were first created by the Halls Brothers company, which was established in 1893. In 1964, the Halls Brothers company was acquired by Warner-Lambert, and later, in 1971, the Halls brand was purchased by Cadbury-Schweppes. Today, Halls is recognized as a global brand. Halls cough drops are marketed with the distinctive feature of vapor action, which is intended to provide a cooling and soothing sensation. They are available in a variety of flavors, including Canada Dry Ginger Ale, Citrus Blend, Cherry, Honey-Lemon, Ice Blue Peppermint, Mentho-Lyptus, Spearmint, Strawberry, Tropical Fruit, and Pina Colada. Additionally, a Green Tea flavor is available in China. The active ingredient in Halls cough drops is menthol, which varies in concentration depending on the flavor. The inactive ingredients differ by flavor and include various colorings, flavorings, and sweeteners. Below is a detailed breakdown of the ingredients for specific flavors: Cherry: Contains 7 mg of menthol as the active ingredient. Inactive ingredients include Blue 2, Red 40, flavors, and glucose syrup. Honey-Lemon: Contains 8 mg of menthol as the active ingredient. Inactive ingredients include beta carotene, honey, soy lecithin, sucrose, flavors, and glucose syrup. Ice Blue Peppermint: Contains 11.2 mg of menthol as the active ingredient. Inactive ingredients include Blue 1, sucrose, flavors, and glucose syrup. Mentho-Lyptus®: Contains 6.5 mg of menthol as the active ingredient. Inactive ingredients include sucrose, flavors, and glucose syrup. Spearmint: Contains 5.6 mg of menthol as the active ingredient. Inactive ingredients include beta carotene, Blue 1, soy lecithin, sucrose, flavors, and glucose syrup. Strawberry: Contains 3.1 mg of menthol as the active ingredient. Inactive ingredients include Red 40, sucrose, flavors, and glucose syrup. Tropical Fruit: Contains 3.1 mg of menthol as the active ingredient. Inactive ingredients include FD&C Red No. 40, water, sucrose, flavors, and glucose syrup. Halls also offers a product line called Halls Defense, which features flavors enriched with Vitamin C. Another product line, Halls Fruit Breezers, is marketed as a non-mentholated lozenge with a pleasant taste. The available flavors in this line include Cool Berry, Cool Creamy Orange, Cool Creamy Strawberry, Tropical Chill, and Cool Citrus Blend. For individuals seeking sugar-free options, Halls provides a sugar-free line of mentholated cough drops. Outside of North America, Halls is often marketed as a mentholated hard candy rather than a medicinal cough drop. In these regions, the product is manufactured in hard candy shapes and is not typically associated with cough relief.
